composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Idempotent create: if the request's 'Idempotency-Key' was already recorded by a previous
# successful create, replay the originally created owner (200) instead of creating a duplicate.
# No header (or a new key) falls through to the normal create pipeline. The key -> owner id
# lookup is in-memory, so this step needs no transaction.
check:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotencyKey
  outputs:
    replay: respondReplay
    proceed: validate

respondReplay:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithReplayedOwner
  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateRequiredOwnerFields
  next: validatePostcode

# Validate the optional postcode WHEN PRESENT (four digits, in-range for the city's region).
# A malformed or out-of-range postcode is a 400 here, before any persistence work.
validatePostcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerPostcode
  next: validateRegistrationDate

# Reject a supplied registrationDate later than the server date (400). Optional field: when
# absent it is not checked and defaults to the server date on build.
validateRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerRegistrationDate
  next: normalizeTelephone

normalizeTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerTelephone
  next: normalizeEmail

normalizeEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerEmail
  next: ensureUniqueIdentity

# Single consolidated duplicate check: the whole identityKey (SHA-256 hex over normalized
# telephone, lower-cased email and soundex(lastName)) must not equal any existing owner's.
ensureUniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueOwnerIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureCityBelowCapacity

ensureCityBelowCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityBelowCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureBelowDailyLimit

ensureBelowDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureBelowDailyLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCustomerCode

assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: countNamesakes

countNamesakes:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CountNamesakes
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: countHouseholdMembers

countHouseholdMembers:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CountHouseholdMembers
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: capMembershipLevel

# A new owner's membershipLevel cannot exceed one above the current maximum membershipLevel among
# existing members of their household. With no existing household member no cap applies. Runs after
# the namesake/household counts it derives the level from and before save so the capped level persists.
capMembershipLevel:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CapMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: flagPossibleDuplicate

# Soft duplicate: not a hard duplicate (that already 409'd), but a differing identityKey whose
# soundex(lastName) and postcode match an existing owner's. Recorded on the owner, not rejected.
flagPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.FlagPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: evaluateBulkSignupWarning

evaluateBulkSignupWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EvaluateBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]

# Record key -> created owner id so a later repeat of the same 'Idempotency-Key' replays this

  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

  govern: [ transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 3
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility;
            when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred. On the response this is
            the composed, normalized address (normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the
            normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The structured first line of the postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when present. Stored and returned normalized (trimmed, whitespace-collapsed,
            upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional structured second line of the postal address. When present it is
            stored and returned normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form
            (a leading '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four digits
            and, for a city whose region is known (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
            fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-08-10'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when present
            it drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner already
            shares its household (same last name and postcode); it is created as a declared
            household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. It does not create the
            household link — the householdId is always derived from last name and postcode.
            Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical relative URL of this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, composed as title + ' ' + lastName when a
                title is supplied, or just the lastName when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the current number of owners.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal digits of the
                customerCode (non-digit separators are ignored).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts
                on 1 July and is named after the calendar year in which it ends, so a July-to-December
                date belongs to the following calendar year's fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the
                last two digits of the fiscal year of the registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household. Derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last
                name (case-insensitive, collapsed whitespace) and postcode, so owners with the same
                last name and postcode share it automatically. Always assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived key all duplicate detection is expressed through, the
                lower-case SHA-256 hex over 'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (the
                email component is empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole
                identityKey is equal.
              type: string
              example: 'a3f5c1e0b2d47689fe10c2b4a6d8091f3c5e7a9b0d2f4681a3c5e7092b4d6f81'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the
                same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, computed on creation. Starts at 0; add 2
                when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3
                or more; add 3 for a tenure over one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 4, derived from
                membershipPoints - 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN'
                when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region using the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the region has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel; 'EMAIL' when the owner has an email
                address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created for the same
                business day as this owner's registrationDate, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner, although not a hard duplicate, shares an existing
                owner's lastName and postcode while having a different telephone; otherwise false. A
                declared household member (created with sharesHousehold=true) is never flagged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches on lastName and
                postcode; present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate;
                'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Present only
                when birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR

## Summary

Implemented the `capacityWarning` flag, mirroring the existing `bulkSignupWarning` pattern.

**What the flag means:** `true` when the owner's city already holds **40–49** other owners (approaching the hard limit of 50); the existing 409 rejection at 50 is untouched.

**Changes:**

1. **`model/Owner.java`** — added a `@Transient Boolean capacityWarning` field with getter/setter (next to `bulkSignupWarning`).

2. **`openapi.yml`** — added the `capacityWarning` read-only boolean to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it and `OwnerMapper` maps it by name automatically.

3. **`function/owner/EvaluateCapacityWarning.java`** (new) — counts owners in the same city (case-insensitive, whitespace-collapsed — matching `EnsureCityBelowCapacity`), **excluding the owner itself**, and sets the flag when the count is in `[40, 49]`.

4. **Pipelines** — inserted an `evaluateCapacityWarning` step after `evaluateBulkSignupWarning` in both `owners.POST.yml` (transaction) and `owners/{ownerId}.GET.yml` (readonly-transaction), so the flag is recomputed on read the same way `bulkSignupWarning` is. **Why exclude self / range [40,49]:** "already has between 40 and 49 owners" refers to the owners the city held apart from this one. Since the hard cap keeps a city's total at ≤ 50, an owner's "other owners in city" count is always ≤ 49, so the warning band never collides with the rejection. The test fills a city to 40, creates the 41st, and the GET sees 40 others → `capacityWarning: true`.
